name: JellySTRMprobe
description: JellySTRMprobe extracts media information from STRM file targets by probing remote streams. Jellyfin never probes STRM files during library scans - this plugin fills that gap. Features: scheduled task to probe all unprobed STRM items, scheduled task to generate trickplay scrubbing previews for STRM items (which Jellyfin skips by design), catch-up mode to auto-probe new STRM items as they are added, configurable parallelism/timeout/cooldown, and per-library selection.
overview: Probe STRM files to extract media info (codec, resolution, duration, audio)

versions.changelog:
- New setting "Timeout per item" (default 60 minutes, 0 = no limit) for the trickplay task. Jellyfin already kills an ffmpeg that stops producing images, but an item that trickles along slowly could otherwise occupy a run for hours with no way out short of cancelling the whole task. A timed-out item is logged and the run continues.
- Cancelling the trickplay task is no longer reported as a generation failure.

- Trickplay is now opt-in and off by default. Generating it streams every file in full, so a run takes a long time; the new "Enable STRM trickplay" setting keeps the task hidden from Scheduled Tasks and refuses to run until you turn it on. Toggling it takes effect without a server restart.
- Fix: with "Maximum items per run" set, the trickplay task re-selected the same first N items on every run and never reached the rest of the library. Items that already have trickplay are now filtered out before the limit is applied.

- New scheduled task "Generate STRM Trickplay": creates trickplay scrubbing previews for STRM items. Jellyfin skips them because its resolver marks .strm files as shortcuts and TrickplayManager.CanGenerateTrickplay() rejects shortcuts.
- Requires the probe task to have run first (needs a duration and a video stream).
- No default trigger; run manually or add a schedule.
- New setting "Maximum items per run" (default 50, 0 = unlimited) so an accidental run cannot pull the entire library through the provider.

- Catch-up mode now also reprobes newly added STRM items that already have media streams but a missing duration (RunTimeTicks null/0), matching the scheduled task's selection.
- Scheduled task also reprobes existing STRM items missing a duration.
